title: Restructure aeos/ into domain subpackages with intra-layer tach enforcement
description:
Follow-on to the lib/ → aeos/ rename (cell-0cec227dd3ea38bf). aeos/ is currently a flat directory of 27 modules with no enforced internal structure. The rename established the external boundaries (fieldkit depends_on aeos, hooks depends_on aeos) but intra-aeos/ imports are completely unenforced — a circular import like config importing from router would be invisible to tach.

Proposed restructure into domain subpackages:

  aeos/
    config/      config.py → __init__.py (path helpers, config loader)
    sf/          sf_direct.py (Salesforce REST client)
    gmail/       gmail_discover.py, name_resolver.py
    llm/         llm.py, llm_log.py, transcribe.py
    pursuit/     pursuit.py, models.py, io.py, stale_prose_check.py
    ingest/      ingest_db.py, drive_docs.py, transcript_pipeline.py, router.py
    watch/       watcher_status.py, watcher_logging.py, watcher_dedup.py
    skill/       skill_template.py
    cli_exit.py  (stays top-level — cross-cutting)
    run_context.py (stays top-level — cross-cutting)
    action_item_classifier.py, tasks_writer.py, dotenv_compat.py, session.py

Tach would then enforce e.g.:
  aeos.config depends_on []
  aeos.sf     depends_on [aeos.config]
  aeos.gmail  depends_on [aeos.config]
  aeos.llm    depends_on []
  aeos.pursuit depends_on [aeos.config]
  aeos.ingest  depends_on [aeos.config, aeos.llm, aeos.gmail]
  aeos.watch   depends_on [aeos.config]

Current implicit layer map (from code analysis):
  Layer 0 — no aeos/ deps: config, pursuit, llm, llm_log, dotenv_compat, session, sf_direct, name_resolver, action_item_classifier, transcribe, watcher_dedup
  Layer 1 — depends on Layer 0: models, cli_exit, ingest_db, gmail_discover, drive_docs, watcher_logging, watcher_status, router, skill_template
  Layer 2 — depends on Layer 1: io, run_context, tasks_writer
  Layer 3 — pipeline orchestrators: stale_prose_check, transcript_pipeline

Scope: ~27 files moved, ~250 import path changes across aeos/, fieldkit/, tests/. Requires design decisions on exact subdomain groupings before implementation. Warrants a Speckit strategic spec.

Parent epic: cell-0cec227dd3ea38bf (rename lib/ → aeos/)
close_reason: Epic: Already completed as part of the lib/ -> aeos/ rename. aeos/ now has 9 well-defined subpackages (config, llm, sf, gmail, pursuit, watch, skill, tasks, ingest) with enforced tach boundaries. Dependency DAG is clean with no cycles. tach.toml boundaries match actual import usage precisely. No further restructuring needed.

title: cobalt-crush-dev.md: fix convention pack loading to use explicit Glob tool call
description:
Source Document #4 in cobalt-crush-dev.md says "Read all `*.md` files from `.opencode/uf/packs/`" but cobalt consistently reads only `python.md` and skips `python-custom.md`. Root cause: vague natural-language instruction satisfied by the first matching file seen.

Fix: replace the current instruction with an explicit Glob tool call:

```markdown
4. **Convention packs** — Use the Glob tool with pattern `.opencode/uf/packs/*.md`
   to list all pack files, then Read each file returned. Do not assume which
   files exist — glob first, then read every result.
```

Evidence: opencode.log run=cc0043fa, all 6 cobalt subagent phases (ses_1343cc81effe through ses_1342b206fffe) read python.md but never python-custom.md. No glob call logged for any phase. The one glob that did appear (line 33729) was from a different session entirely.
close_reason: Fixed in commit 44076e3. cobalt-crush-dev.md now has explicit Glob tool call: Use the Glob tool with pattern .opencode/uf/packs/*.md to list all pack files, then Read each file returned. Merged to main.

title: Rename lib/ → aeos/ (domain layer identity)
description:
lib/ is the most generic name possible — it says nothing about what's in it or why it exists. Rename it to aeos/ to match the product identity (aeos/fieldkit-cmd), make imports self-documenting (from aeos.gmail import ...), and clarify the two-layer architecture: aeos/ (domain logic) vs fieldkit/ (CLI adapter). tach rules become readable: fieldkit depends_on aeos, hooks depends_on aeos.

Pure mechanical rename — no logic changes, no restructuring of modules within the directory. 124 Python files need import updates across fieldkit/, tests/, lib/ (becoming aeos/), hooks/, and scripts/. pyproject.toml, tach.toml, and all documentation updated accordingly. Auto-generated docs regenerated via make docs.
close_reason: Merged to main (6c0dd83). lib/ → aeos/ rename complete, all subtasks done.
